SpectrumSort

Murphy dropped the light waves. Put them back in order, fast and neat.

How scoring works

Each round starts at 1,000 points. You get 10 free seconds, then lose 6 points every second. Each swap beyond "par" (the fewest swaps possible) costs 20. Murphy's hint costs 150. Finish on par and earn +100.

Swap two cards by dragging one onto another, or tap one card and then tap another.
